components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The owner's optional honorific title. When present it must be one of
            MR, MRS, MS or DR, and it is used to derive the read-only 'salutation'.
          type: string
          enum:
            - MR
            - MRS
            - MS
            - DR
          example: DR
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted on input for backward
            compatibility, but the structured 'addressLine1'/'addressLine2' fields are preferred
            when present. On output it is the composed address — the normalized 'addressLine1' with
            a single space and the normalized 'addressLine2' appended when 'addressLine2' is present.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: The first line of the structured postal address. Preferred over the flat
            'address' when present; a non-blank value satisfies the address requirement. Normalized
            (trimmed, whitespace collapsed, upper-cased, common abbreviations expanded) on create.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: The optional second line of the structured postal address. Normalized like
            'addressLine1' and, when present, appended to the composed 'address'.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apt 4B'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^\+[0-9]{8,15}$'
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be a
            syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional; validated only when present. When
            supplied it must be a valid postcode for the city's region using a fixed table
            (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099); a city with no known region accepts any
            4-digit postcode. Stored and returned as given.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the pet owner was registered. Optional on create; when omitted it
            defaults to the server's current date. Returned in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2013-01-01'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: The pet owner's date of birth. Optional; when present it is used to derive
            the owner's 'ageBand', computed against the registrationDate. Returned in ISO
            'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: Request-only flag. When true, allow creating this owner even though another
            owner already has the same last name and address (same household). Never returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: Franklin, George
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: The owner's salutation, derived at read time. When a 'title' is on record
                it is the title, a single space, then the lastName; otherwise just the lastName.
              type: string
              example: DR Franklin
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: G.F.
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: The stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans, derived at read time as
                the country code, a space, then the national digits grouped in threes from the left.
                The raw 'telephone' field stays in E.164 form.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            apiVersion:
              title: API version
              description: The owner identity schema version. Version 2 groups the derived
                identifiers under the 'identity' object and rederives each with a fixed 'V2' tag so
                no value equals one produced under version 1.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            identity:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerIdentity'
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: The fiscal year the owner's registrationDate falls in, formatted 'FY<YY>'
                where YY is the last two digits of the fiscal year. The fiscal year starts on 1 July,
                so a registrationDate on or after 1 July belongs to the next calendar year's fiscal
                year. Derived at read time from the business-day-adjusted registrationDate.
              type: string
              example: FY26
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: The number of existing owners that shared this owner's firstName and
                lastName (compared case-insensitively) at the time this owner was created, before
                this owner itself was added.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: The owner's membership points, fixed at creation. Start at 0 and accumulate
                2 when the owner has an email address on record, 1 when the owner had no namesakes at
                creation (namesakeCount is 0), 2 for a household of 3 or more members, and 3 when the
                owner's tenure exceeds one elapsed fiscal year.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: The owner's numeric membership level, mapped from membershipPoints; 1 for
                0-1 points, 2 for 2-3 points, 3 for 4-5 points, and 4 for 6 or more points.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: The owner's region, derived at read time from the city using a fixed
                city-to-region table (Sydney -> NSW, Melbourne -> VIC, Brisbane -> QLD). 'UNKNOWN'
                when the city is not in the table.
              type: string
              example: NSW
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: The owner's segment, formatted '<TIER>_<AREA>' — one of 'PREMIUM_METRO',
                'PREMIUM_REGIONAL', 'STANDARD_METRO' or 'STANDARD_REGIONAL'. TIER is 'PREMIUM' when
                membershipLevel is 3 or more, otherwise 'STANDARD'. AREA is 'METRO' when the locality
                is a known region (NSW, VIC or QLD), otherwise 'REGIONAL'.
              type: string
              example: PREMIUM_METRO
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: The owner's IANA timezone, derived at read time from the locality/region
                using a fixed region-to-timezone table (NSW -> Australia/Sydney, VIC ->
                Australia/Melbourne, QLD -> Australia/Brisbane). Absent when the region is 'UNKNOWN'.
              type: string
              example: Australia/Sydney
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: True when more than 80 owners had already been created for this owner's
                registration business day at the time this owner was created; otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: True when this owner's city already held between 40 and 49 owners
                (inclusive) at the time this owner was created, approaching the per-city capacity
                limit of 50; otherwise false. A create is hard-rejected once the city holds 50.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: The owner's preferred contact channel, derived at read time. 'EMAIL' when
                the owner has an email address on record, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: EMAIL
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: The owner's age band, derived at read time from birthDate against the
                registrationDate. 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' from 18 to 64, and 'SENIOR' at 65
                or older. Absent when no birthDate is on record.
              type: string
              example: ADULT
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: True when this owner, though not a hard duplicate, shared an existing
                owner's lastName and postcode (with a different telephone) at the time it was
                created; otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: The id of the existing owner this owner was flagged as a possible
                duplicate of. Present only when possibleDuplicate is true.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 42
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: Whether this owner has been soft-deleted. A newly created owner is false.
                DELETE /api/owners/{ownerId} sets it true while retaining the record, so the owner is
                still readable and the create endpoint's duplicate/identity checks ignore it.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: The canonical path to this owner, derived at read time as '/api/owners/'
                followed by the owner's id.
              type: string
              example: /api/owners/1
              readOnly: true
            riskFlag:
              title: Risk flag
              description: True when any of these hold, otherwise false, derived at read time; the
                owner is a possible duplicate (possibleDuplicate is true), the email domain is
                disposable-adjacent (not itself a blocked disposable domain, but a subdomain of one
                or sharing a blocked disposable provider's second-level label under another TLD), or
                the city is over its soft capacity (capacityWarning is true).
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets
    OwnerPage:
      title: Owner page
      description: A page of pet owners.
      type: object
      properties:
        content:
          title: Content
          description: Pet owners in the requested page.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        page:
          title: Page
          description: Zero-based page index.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 0
        size:
          title: Size
          description: Requested page size.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 1
          example: 5
        totalElements:
          title: Total elements
          description: Total number of owners matching the request.
          type: integer
          format: int64
          minimum: 0
          example: 10

## Summary

I released version 2 of the owner identity. The change touches identity derivation, the response shape, the audit schema, and the owner segment together — while keeping the user-facing region fields plain.

**New shared version marker** — `IdentityVersion` (`common/`): `TAG = "V2"` and `VERSION = 2`, the single source for the mixed-in tag and the version numbers.

**Rederived every identifier with the V2 tag** (so no v1 value can recur):
- `MemberIds` — the region code *inside* the `memberId` now appends the `V2` tag (e.g. `NSWV2261A2B3C4D7`), via a new private `identityRegionOf`. `localityOf` stays plain, so `locality`, `timezone` and the owner segment's region are unaffected.
- `IdentityKeys` — SHA-256 input now prefixed with `V2|…`; still a 64-hex key.
- `Households` — `householdId` hash input now prefixed with `V2|…`; still deterministic per (lastName, postcode).

**Response shape** (`openapi.yml` + `OwnerMapper`):
- Added top-level integer `apiVersion` = 2.
- Added a new `OwnerIdentity` schema; `memberId`, `identityKey` and `householdId` moved under a nested `identity` object and removed from the top level. The mapper builds it via a new `toIdentity(owner)` helper.

**Audit event** (`OwnerCreatedEvent`) — bumped to schema version 2 by adding `"schemaVersion":2`; it still carries the owner id and the (now v2) `memberId`. The owner segment is recomputed as before from the plain region, staying `STANDARD_METRO`/etc.

The `locality` ("NSW"), `timezone` ("Australia/Sydney") and `ownerSegment` all remain on the plain region code; the `V2` tag appears only inside the identifiers. Request fields are unchanged.
